subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow upstream fix for this Telegram approval cleanup?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but the remaining open closing PR is outside the target repository, conflicting, not maintainer-modifiable, and aimed at the obsolete handler path; automation should not queue a replacement until maintainers decide that PR’s fate.

options.title: Close fork PR and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as the landing path, then allow a narrow upstream PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can manually recreate the useful behavior from the fork PR on the active runtime path, discarding the obsolete handler and unrelated docs churn.

options.title: Keep waiting on fork PR
options.body: Leave this issue paired to the fork PR, accepting that the target repo remains unfixed until that conflicting branch is replaced or repaired by its author.

recommendation.title: Close fork PR and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the conflicting fork PR as the landing path, then allow a narrow upstream PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The routing decision centers on the native approval lifecycle path introduced in gumadeiras’ refactor.
